CON oauth_access_tokens oauth_access_tokens_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON oauth_clients oauth_clients_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON oauth_clients oauth_clients_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON policies policies_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON policies policies_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON postures postures_expressions_not_null NOT NULL expressions
CON postures postures_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON postures postures_name_not_null NOT NULL name
CON postures postures_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON pre_auth_keys fk_pre_auth_keys_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CON pre_auth_keys pre_auth_keys_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON pre_auth_keys pre_auth_keys_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON sessions fk_sessions_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CON sessions sessions_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON sessions sessions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON sessions sessions_token_hash_not_null NOT NULL token_hash
CON sessions sessions_user_id_not_null NOT NULL user_id
CON settings settings_key_not_null NOT NULL key
CON settings settings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (key)
CON users users_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON users users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON webhook_deliveries fk_webhook_deliveries_webhook FOREIGN KEY (webhook_id) REFERENCES webhooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_attempts_not_null NOT NULL attempts
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_created_at_not_null NOT NULL created_at
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_duration_ms_not_null NOT NULL duration_ms
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_event_type_not_null NOT NULL event_type
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_ok_not_null NOT NULL ok
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_status_not_null NOT NULL status
CON webhook_deliveries webhook_deliveries_webhook_id_not_null NOT NULL webhook_id
CON webhooks webhooks_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON webhooks webhooks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON webhooks webhooks_secret_not_null NOT NULL secret
CON webhooks webhooks_subscriptions_not_null NOT NULL subscriptions
CON webhooks webhooks_url_not_null NOT NULL url
